Hair turns grey (medically called **canities**) when hair follicles stop producing **melanin** , the pigment that gives hair its color according to the [American Academy of Dermatology](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes) . As melanocyte stem cells die or lose function, new strands grow in clear, white, or silver rather than pigmented.[[1]](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/gray-hair)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greying_of_hair)

### Main Causes

- **Genetics:** The biggest factor in when and how fast you turn grey.
- **Aging:** Natural cellular wear over time.
- **Stress:** Chronic stress releases hormones like norepinephrine, which can deplete pigment-producing stem cells.
- **Lifestyle:** Smoking and environmental pollution increase oxidative stress and damage follicles.
- **Nutritional Deficiencies:** Low levels of vitamin B12, iron, copper, or zinc can trigger premature greying.
- **Medical Conditions:** Thyroid disorders and autoimmune diseases (like vitiligo or alopecia areata) can impact pigment cells.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12182098/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GaZlBcSoQFo&t=39)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/DrDorisDay/videos/hair-turns-grey-for-so-many-reasons-grey-or-white-hair-in-and-of-itself-is-not-a/762708776074280/)[[4]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/gray-hair)[[5]](https://www.wella.com/professional/en-US/blog/hair-color/how-to-get-rid-of-grey-hair)

### Can You Reverse It?

- **Age-related greying** is permanent and irreversible.[[1]](https://www.artofmanliness.com/style/grooming/how-to-deal-with-going-gray/)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/gray-hair)
- **Premature greying** caused by a specific vitamin deficiency or underlying health issue may sometimes slow or stop if the root cause is treated by a doctor.[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/gray-hair)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=17BlB0W3b6s&t=35)
- **Covering or blending** options include permanent or demi-permanent hair dyes, root touch-ups, highlights, or purple shampoos to tone silver hair.[[1]](https://www.wella.com/professional/en-US/blog/hair-color/how-to-prevent-grey-hair)

If you'd like to share **your age** or **when you first noticed the greying** , I can help you look into specific coverage tips or lifestyle adjustments.
